messages:
Alex H: @security-team quick question — prospect (mid-market finance) asked what we can provide for ISO/ISMS alignment for a short POC. They want applicability + evidence they can review in a week.
Sara P: Short answer: SoA, ISMS scope statement, a CAIQ/SIG crosswalk, risk summary, and a few implementation artifacts (KMS diagram, network/VPC diagram, sample SoC docs). We can redact customer data.
Rajiv K: We'll prepare a CAIQ-lite mapping. Also check control owners for anything marked 'not implemented' in the SoA.
Emily S: For Dedicated + Private options: we can provide VPC diagrams and KMS architecture. On-prem (air-gapped) is out of scope for our hosted ISMS; we'll note that in applicability.
Alex H: Client specifically asked about encryption at rest and KMS/HSM — do we have a redacted config or architecture we can share now?
SecBot: Incident bot: No incidents in us-east-1 impacting inference services in the last 90 days. (auto)
Sara P: Draft applicability statement we usually use: "Redwood's ISMS scope covers the control plane, hosted inference service, and Redwood-managed Dedicated capacity. Customer-managed on-prem hardware and customer-controlled physical premises are excluded. Private VPC networking operated by the customer is partially out-of-scope; Redwood controls apply to service components within the customer-managed VPC where Redwood is the operator." We'll tailor wording for the POC.
Alex H: Can you drop a short checklist I can send to the prospect?
Sara P: Yes — sending. Please use redacted artifacts only.
Sara P: ```
POC ISO evidence checklist
- ISMS scope statement (pdf)
- Statement of Applicability (xlsx) with control statuses
- Risk assessment summary (pdf)
- CAIQ -> SoA crosswalk (xlsx)
- KMS/HSM architecture diagram (png) - redacted
- Network / VPC diagram (png) - redacted
- Sample policy excerpts (access control, encryption) (pdf)
- Last internal ISO audit date + certification snapshot (pdf)
``` 
Rajiv K: Add a single-line mapping: control owner + contact for any control marked implemented.
Emily S: Audit dates: internal ISO audit 2025-11-12, cert snapshot (valid until 2026-05-30) — I can attach copies.
Alex H: Client requested timeline — can we assemble by Thursday EOD? Their review meeting is Friday.
Emily S: I can have the first package ready Thu 10:30 PT. Will redact hostnames and customer-specific metrics.
Lena G: FYI on pricing: if they request extended Dedicated capacity for the POC beyond free credits we'll need PO/SOW. I can approve up to a modest credit; otherwise will route for approval.
Alex H: Great — I'll tell them ETA Thu morning and ask if they want the Dedicated trial. Thanks team :thumbsup:
Sara P: I'll start compiling docs and upload to <https://redwood.internal/docs/iso-evidence|ISO evidence repo> — will @mention when ready.
Alex H: Thanks all.
